status: Standalone implementation proposal; not frozen TC0-A authority
capture_order: Increasing numeric binding ID; exact free lexical bindings; support always empty
staging: Let dispatch saves environment and tail destination; LetReturn binds and enters body
Apply/add collects left then right; final collection produces Ready only
Ready apply enters code using captured bindings plus parameter; no body instruction executes
Tail apply reuses destination; non-tail apply pushes Return with caller environment
ReturnReturn restores caller environment and propagates Value only
Ready add uses exact I64 and begins Overflow unwind when needed
Unwind discards one frame per step
Root Value/Unwind enters Join; Join emits ScopeExit; Terminate emits TaskTermination
limitations: No full A artifact/source map contract
No named calls, recursion, emit, tuples, datatypes or regions
No compatibility with existing arithmetic-demo replay identity
